itemList.description: Pumpset: Supply of New brand sewage submerible pump coupled to brand new squiral cage induction motar of Suitable Hp F class Inslation. The submercible sewage  pump shall be monoblock type with non clog design. The pump shall be of 1450 RPM  . The Pump should be able to pass through soft solids of 40mm dia and capable of delivery sludge with specific gravity of 1.05 implerrs should be single /double vane nan-clog type of CF weight 8M material & with wearing rings. The Pump designed should be such as to facilitate automatic instalation / removal of pump with out having to enter into the sewage pit. profile gasket should be provided in automatic couplling system to avoid metal to metal contact between the pump and delevery pipe to ensure leak proof joint. Material of Construction:                                                                                                   1) PUMP CASING : The Pump Casing shall be CI as per IS:210 GRFG 260 with 2 to 3% Nickle . The Casing shall have central line Discharge.                                                                                                                  2) IMPELLER: The Impellr Shall be of Stainless steel grade  CF 8M Single /Double Vane  Non-clog  design for disposal of Material.                                                                                                         3)PUMP SHAFT: The Pumo shaft shall be of hard chrome plate alloy steel of stainless steel SS 410 as per the manufacturers standards and shall be of one piece construction.                                          4)PUMP BEARING: The Pump bearing shall be of antifriction type. The bearing shall be able to take normal thrust loads due to unbalanced hydraulic loads on the Impeller plus  the weight of all the rotating parts of the pump. The Pump bearings shall be designed with minimum life of 40,000hrs. The Bearing shall be Grease Lubricated.                                                    Note: Submercible pumpset should be installed in the wetwell and wil be submerged with sewage . Hence the pump set should suit above of system                                                                                                                                                                    Head - 25.2m/Suitability   Capacity - 40Hp  Voltage -415  Q- 31-46 cum/hr.    Phase - 3   Pump Size - 0323/D065-227   50Hz   Kw/Hp - 3.7 /5 .0    Speed - 2900RPM
